cases.question: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.
cases.baseline_sql:
SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
    SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM frpm f2
    JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
);

cases.question: What are the webpages for the Los Angeles County school that has between 2,000 and 3,000 test takers?
cases.baseline_sql:
SELECT s.Website 
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles County'
  AND sc.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

cases.question: What atoms comprise TR186?
cases.baseline_sql: SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 186;

cases.question: What is the carcinogenic label for bond TR001_2_4?
cases.baseline_sql:
SELECT m.label 
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = 'TR001_2_4';

cases.question: Which of the cards that are a promotional painting have multiple faces on the same card? Please list their names.
cases.baseline_sql:
SELECT name
FROM cards
WHERE isPromo = 1 AND side IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT side) > 1;

cases.question: Among the sets whose expansion type is Commander, which set has the highest total number of cards including promotional and related supplemental products but excluding Alchemy modifications? Indicate the id of the set.
cases.baseline_sql:
SELECT sets.id
FROM sets
WHERE sets.type = 'Commander'
ORDER BY COALESCE(sets.totalSetSize, 0) DESC
LIMIT 1;

cases.question: Which user added a bounty amount of 50 to the post title mentioning variance?
cases.baseline_sql:
SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
JOIN votes v ON p.Id = v.PostId AND u.Id = v.UserId
WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50
AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%';

cases.question: Provide the full name of the superhero named Alien.
cases.baseline_sql:
SELECT s.full_name 
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Alien' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel';

cases.question: Name all drivers in the 2010 Singapore Grand Prix order by their position stands.
cases.baseline_sql:
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, ds.position
FROM drivers d
JOIN driverStandings ds ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2010 AND r.name = 'Singapore'
ORDER BY ds.position;

cases.question: Please list the location coordinates of the circuits whose lap record is 1:29.488.
cases.baseline_sql:
SELECT lat, lng
FROM circuits
WHERE circuitId IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.circuitId
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%1:29.488%'
       OR CAST(res.fastestLapTime AS TEXT) = '00:01:29.488'
);

cases.question: For the patient who was diagnosed with SLE on 1994/2/19, what was his/her anti-Cardiolipin antibody concentration status on 1993/11/12?
cases.baseline_sql: SELECT Examination.[aCL IgM] FROM Examination INNER JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Patient.Description = '1994-02-19' AND Examination.[Examination Date] = '1993/11/12';

cases.question: Please indicate the college of the person whose first name is Katy with the link to the major "rec1N0upiVLy5esTO".
cases.baseline_sql:
SELECT major.college 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE member.first_name = 'Katy' AND major.college = 'rec1N0upiVLy5esTO';
